opportunities.name: United flight search (origin, destination, dates, travelers, cabin)
opportunities.description: Search United flights from {origin} to {destination} for {depart_date}–{return_date} with {passengers}/{cabin}, optionally paying with miles, then pick a fare.
steps: Open the BOOK tab and choose Flight (check 'Book with miles' if needed)
Type the origin city in 'departing city' and pick the matching airport
Type the destination city and pick the matching airport
Open the Depart date picker, go to the right month, and click the depart and return dates
Set the traveler counts (adults/children) and the cabin class
Click 'Find flights'
Optionally select a roundtrip fare from the results

instances.values: Sacramento (SMF) → Houston (IAH), book with miles, 20.9k miles fare
Baltimore (BWI) → New York (NYC), Aug 2–Aug 7 2023, adults adjusted
Pune (PNQ) → New York (NYC), selected $2,984 economy roundtrip
Santa Fe (SAF) → Phoenix (PHX), dates 13–28 next month, selected $681 economy roundtrip

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: Find parking near {venue} for {event}, optionally setting {event_date}, {filters}, {sort}, and {start/end time}, then book or review the results.
steps: Type the venue into 'Search for parking' and pick the suggestion
Optionally choose the event date in 'Select Event Date'
Click the event you want
Optionally open Filter, check amenities (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible), and show the results
Optionally change the sort order (Distance/Price)
Optionally set Start Time/End Time and click 'Update Search'
Optionally click 'Book Now' on a spot

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets, sort by Distance, 3PM–5PM, Book Now
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals, Wheelchair Accessible, sort by Price
Barclays Center, Apr 9 2023, 76ers at Nets, Wheelchair Accessible, start 10AM

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search by location with a filter
opportunities.description: Find restaurants in {location} on TripAdvisor and filter them by {cuisine/feature}.
steps: Click 'Restaurants'
Type the location into Search and pick the matching place
Optionally click 'More restaurants in…'
Click 'Show more' in the filters if needed, then check the cuisine/feature filter
Click Apply (and optionally limit the search to the location or use Order online)

instances.values: Los Angeles, Indian, limited to LA, Order online

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor 'Hire a Trip Designer' request
opportunities.description: Fill out the Trip Designer questionnaire for {destination}, {dates}, {trip_type}, {preferences/interests}, {travelers}, and {budget}.
steps: Open the menu and click 'Hire a Trip Designer'
Search for the destination, select it, and click 'Get Started'
Pick the start and end dates in the calendar, then click Next
Choose the trip type and dietary preferences, then click Next
Set the traveler counts (children ages), then click Next
Choose the budget, then click Next
Select interests (e.g. Must See, Local Cuisine, History, Shopping, Adventurous), then click Next

instances.values: Egypt, Jul 1–Jul 4 2023, Family Vacation, Kosher, child age 8, $4,000
$6,000 budget; interests Must See, Local Cuisine, History, Shopping, Indigenous traditions, Adventurous

opportunities.name: United 'Flying from' deals/destination search
opportunities.description: Search United deals or flexible-date fares departing from {origin_city}.
steps: Type the city into 'Flying from' and pick the airport
Optionally set the search type (Roundtrip) and choose Flexible dates
Click Search and browse the results list
